{{Top|notoc=1}}
A '''standard hour''', also known simply as an '''hour''', was a [[Galactic Standard Time/Legends|standardized]] [[Time/Legends|temporal]] measurement unit used in many parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

An hour was equal to sixty [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], there were 24 hours in a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] and 368 days per [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="Under a Black Sun">''[[Under a Black Sun]]''</ref>
